payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check all pairs of intervals formed by consecutive points; if two intervals intersect (one contains an endpoint of the other but not both), output 'yes' immediately; else after all pairs, output 'no'.
payload.rationale: The code performs exhaustive pairwise checking of semi-circles using interval inclusion; this is a complete search. The subtype 'search_backtracking' is selected because it is the most general complete-search subtype among given options, even though no backtracking occurs.
